name: @playform/hook-dsh-normalize-quotes
description: The quotes hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the llm/stream waterfall — the interceptable wrapper around EVERY streaming model call — and normalizes the curly quote family (U+2018 left single quotation mark, U+2019 right single quotation mark, U+201A single low-9 quotation mark, U+201B single high-reversed-9 quotation mark, U+201C left double quotation mark, U+201D right double quotation mark, U+201E double low-9 quotation mark, U+201F double high-reversed-9 quotation mark) in model output streams, the family's quotes flavor — the MAP flavor: the core's Quotes char→char map replaces each typographic quote code point with its ASCII straight counterpart (' / ") in text/reasoning deltas and assembled block-end blocks while tool-call deltas pass through untouched.
